annotations.text:
Vox-Scribe redesign — three directions, same screens (main window + dictation pill).
A · Aquila: imperial-modern. Chamfered panels, gold on warm black, Cinzel display. Grandeur without steampunk.
B · Void Glass: the most modern. Cool dark glass, cyan signal color, rounded and soft. Least Warhammer.
C · Cogitator: machine-cult brutalism. Hard edges, signal red + amber on carbon, corner ticks, dense data. Most Warhammer.
Pick one and Main becomes the full build-out.
